She is sometimes referred to as "Lady Rainbow" or "She of the Pale Face" and is also known as Goddess O in the Dresden Codex. Ixchel is often depicted as an old woman with jaguar ears, a snake on her head, and an overturned jar in her hands, and she is sometimes associated with the younger Goddess I or Ixik Kab. In some myths, she is the wife of Itzamná, the god of heaven and wisdom, and together they are credited with creating the Bacab, four deities who hold up the corners of the world.
